item.chapter_label: Earth, Sun and the apparent motion of the sky
item.stem:
The diagram shows Earth on about 21 June. Kiara compares daytime length at place P near the North Pole, place E on the Equator, and place S in the Southern Hemisphere.

Which claims are correct? One or more options may be correct.

options.A: Around 21 June the Northern Hemisphere has its longest day.
options.B: At the Equator there are about 12 hours of daylight and 12 hours of darkness.
options.C: The Northern Hemisphere's longest day occurs at the March equinox.
options.D: After 21 June, Northern Hemisphere days become longer and nights become shorter.
